business.name: Ember
business.business_model: Direct-to-consumer streetwear and custom-printed apparel, with a secondary uniform and wholesale line. Orders arrive through Instagram DM, WhatsApp, and an on-site basket that emails the order; payment is cash on delivery or CliQ bank transfer confirmed manually. No payment gateway and no backend order system.

objective.primary: Acquire qualified order leads for Ember apparel at a sustainable cost per lead, on Meta only, at a small weekly test budget. The budget figure is held outside this artifact by design.
objective.conversion_definition: A qualified order lead, counted as any one of: (a) a WhatsApp click-to-message conversation started from an ad or the site, (b) an Instagram DM enquiry attributable to paid delivery, or (c) a completed on-site checkout submission that emails an order. Payment confirmation (CliQ screenshot or cash on delivery) happens offline and is NOT part of the ad-platform conversion signal; it is reconciled manually.
success_metrics: qualified lead to paid-order rate, reconciled manually from order emails and WhatsApp
MER (total revenue / total ad spend) at the monthly level
landing-page-view to lead rate on ember-jo.netlify.app

OPERATOR DECISION (2026-08-01): the conversion is any qualified order lead across WhatsApp, Instagram DM, and on-site checkout.

RISK (2026-08-01): the ad account bills and reports in USD while the shop prices in JOD. Ad account currency cannot be changed once spending starts. Pixel event values are therefore sent in JOD with an explicit currency code so Meta converts them correctly; sending JOD figures labelled USD would overstate every order by roughly 40 percent.

Browser verification on localhost confirmed fbevents.js 2.9.368 loaded, the signals config for the pixel ID returned, and PageView, Contact, and Lead all reached facebook.com/tr with cd[content_name], cd[value], and cd[currency]=JOD intact.

Purchase is deliberately never fired, because payment is cash on delivery or CliQ and has not occurred at the point of any on-site event.

Adding credentials, customer lists, audience files, account exports, or commercial figures voids this classification and requires verified at-rest encryption first — this workstation currently has none.
